footer.tagline: Find your righteous spouse in a safe, Sharia-compliant environment. Premium matchmaking for the Muslim community.
home.heroDesc: Join thousands of sincere Muslims finding their righteous spouse the halal way. Verified profiles, family involvement, and Sharia-compliant matchmaking — all in one trusted platform.
home.ctaDesc: Create your free profile today and join a community of sincere Muslims committed to marriage the halal way. Takes 5 minutes. No hidden fees.
home.ctaTrust: Trusted by thousands of Muslim families across Ethiopia
home.featuresTitle: Everything You Need to Find Your Spouse
home.featuresSubtitle: Powerful tools designed around Islamic values to help you find your righteous partner with confidence.
home.feature1Desc: Our algorithm considers deen, character, education, lifestyle, and life goals to find truly compatible matches — not just surface-level traits.
home.feature2Desc: Every member goes through manual ID verification. No bots, no fake accounts. Only genuine Muslims serious about marriage.
home.feature3Desc: Communicate safely with end-to-end encrypted messages. You control who can contact you and what information you share.
home.feature4Desc: Optionally invite your wali or family members to review profiles and participate in the process — maintaining Islamic guidelines every step.
home.feature5Desc: Filter potential matches by city, education, occupation, religious commitment, marital status, and more to find exactly what you're looking for.
home.feature6Desc: Optional, encrypted health information sharing lets you make informed decisions with complete privacy and mutual consent.
home.premiumFeature1Desc: Chat freely with any verified member
home.premiumFeature2Desc: Your profile appears first in searches
home.premiumFeature3Desc: Filter by city, occupation, education & more
home.premiumFeature4Desc: Stand out with a premium badge on your profile
home.premiumFeature5Desc: Know when your messages are seen
home.premiumFooter: Sign up free — upgrade anytime. No hidden fees.
home.trustSubtitle: Every feature, every decision — rooted in sincerity, transparency, and Islamic ethics.
home.trust1Desc: Every member undergoes manual ID verification. No bots, no fake profiles, no compromises on authenticity.
home.trust2Desc: Your data is protected with enterprise-grade encryption. You control what you share and with whom.
home.trust3Desc: Designed around Islamic values. Guardian involvement, respectful communication, and marriage-first approach.
home.trust4Desc: Optional wali access allows family to participate in the process with dignity and transparency.
home.journeyTitle: The Path to a Blessed Union
home.journeySubtitle: Every great marriage begins with intention. Here is how we walk with you.
home.journeyStep1Desc: Share your story, values, and what you seek in a spouse. Thoughtful questions guide every step.
home.journeyStep2Desc: Upload your ID and take a selfie. Our team reviews and verifies your identity within 24 hours.
home.journeyStep3Desc: Our algorithm matches you based on deen, character, education, and life goals — not just appearances.
home.journeyStep4Desc: Engage in meaningful conversations within a safe, monitored environment with full privacy controls.
home.journeyStep5Desc: Invite your wali or family to review profiles and participate in the process when you're ready.
home.journeyStep6Desc: When hearts align, we support your journey toward a blessed union grounded in faith and mutual respect.
home.benefitsTitle: Everything You Need for a Blessed Marriage
home.benefitsSubtitle: A platform built on Islamic values, designed to help you find your righteous spouse with confidence and peace of mind.
home.benefit1Desc: Create your profile and browse compatible matches at no cost. No hidden fees, no credit card required to start.
home.benefit2Desc: Every member goes through ID verification. No fake profiles, no bots — only genuine Muslims serious about marriage.
home.benefit3Desc: Wali involvement, modest interactions, and Islamic guidelines built into every step of your journey.
home.benefit4Desc: Our algorithm matches you based on deen, character, education, and life goals — not just appearances.
home.benefit5Desc: Your data is encrypted and never shared. You control who sees your profile, photos, and contact information.
home.benefit6Desc: Invite your wali or family members to review profiles and participate in the process when you're ready.
home.benefit7Desc: Optional, encrypted health information sharing lets you make informed decisions with complete privacy and mutual consent.
home.benefit8Desc: Built specifically for the Ethiopian Muslim community. Connect with singles from Addis Ababa, Dire Dawa, Adama, and across the country.
home.benefitsCtaDesc: Join today — it takes only 5 minutes
